dct_title_s: Damage assessment along the Debed river in Tumanian Municipality, Lori Province, Armenia as of 29 May 2024
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20240528ARM, GDACS ID: 1102647** This map illustrates satellite based structure damage assessment along the Debed river in Tumanian Municipality, Lori Province as observed from a Pléiades imagery acquired on the 29 May 2024 at 11:39 local time. UNOSAT observed 113 potentially affected buildings, 12 potentially affected bridges, 16 potentially affected road segments and 5 potentially affected railway segments. Based on Worldpop population data, about 3,000 people live within 200m from the Debed river. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
